result.stdout:
Zest v0.6.1 — Zealous Efficient Static Toolkit
Ecosystem: .zest.fsx + .zcss


  ── Usage ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Usage: zest <command> [options]


  ── Commands ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
build                       Build static site to _site/
serve                       Build + start dev server (live reload)
preview                     Preview built _site/ directory
init                        Scaffold new project from template
  zest scaffold <template> [path]   Generate project from preset (blog/docs/portfolio/empty)
  zest migrate <source-ssg>         Migrate from Jekyll/Hexo/Hugo/11ty (--from --to --dry-run)
  zest convert-config <from> <to>   Convert _config between YAML ↔ TOML
  zest clean [--cache] [--output]   Clear build artifacts (default: both)
--version, -v               Show version info
--help,    -h               Show this help


  ── Options ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
--port, -p PORT             Server port (default: 8080)
--watch, -w                 Watch files and auto-rebuild


  ── File Formats ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.zest.fsx  F# template scripts with HTML DSL & Markdown
  .njk       Nunjucks-compatible templates
  .liquid    Liquid templates (Jinja2 family, Nunjucks-compatible)
  .hbs       Handlebars templates (auto-converted to Nunjucks)
  .mustache  Mustache templates (auto-converted to Nunjucks)
  .webc      WebC components (SSR-processed)
  .haml      HAML templates (auto-converted)
  .pug       Pug templates (auto-converted)
  .html      HTML files (Nunjucks-preprocessed when template syntax detected)
  .zcss       Zest Stylesheet — CSS superset with nesting/vars
  .toml       Site config & global data (zero-config by default)
  .js         Client scripts, copied as-is to output
  .md         Standard Markdown content files

  Run 'zest <command> --help' for command-specific options.
